item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire image edge to edge. Treat it as an imagined visual metaphor for cognition: many competing possibilities briefly finding coherence, then opening into uncertainty again. A broad field of warm chalk white holds uneven concentrations of midnight blue, bruised violet, and charcoal. Near the lower left, dense impasto accumulates through scraped, interrupted gestures; thin translucent washes push outward and dissolve into generous empty space toward the upper right. Small, fierce passages of vermilion and acid yellow interrupt the darker layers, sometimes buried, sometimes exposed. Let rhythm emerge through repetition with subtle differences: marks that hesitate, overlap, redirect, and almost align without becoming a pattern. Alternate dry, abrasive brushwork with luminous veils and thick ridges of paint. Preserve erased passages, ghosted edges, and partially covered strokes so revision remains physically visible. Build spatial tension between compression and release, agitation and stillness, sharp contrast and nearly imperceptible tonal shifts. The composition should feel searching, unresolved, and attentive, with no single center and no tidy visual conclusion. Painterly material detail, tactile surface, nuanced color, deliberate asymmetry. Absolutely no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting; only the square painting filling the entire image."}
